purpose: Show CRM stage flow with numbered colour-coded columns, white cards and a complete list alternative.

openCard.description: Requests card detail without hidden mutation.

accessibility.keyboard: Every card opens by button; stage change uses a labelled native control.
accessibility.focus: Preview close restores the originating card or list row.
accessibility.screenReader: Column number, name, count and card status are text.

invariants: Pointer drag is progressive enhancement over the native stage selector.
List alternative exposes every card and action.
Drag and drop is never required.
Move request never mutates before preview and confirmation.
